name: Maybank Securities (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Maybank Securities (Thailand) Public Company Limited, identified by the symbol MST.BK, offers a comprehensive spectrum of investment and financial services to institutional and individual clientele throughout Thailand. Its activities are segmented into two core areas: Securities Business and Investment Banking. Within the Securities Business division, the company provides services such as online and retail brokerage, derivatives and warrants trading, offshore trading, mutual funds, block trades, and institutional sales, additionally acting as a broker agent. The Investment Banking segment specializes in advisory services, encompassing securities offerings, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), independent financial advice, and debt and corporate restructuring. This segment further handles investment management, underwriting, and transactions involving securities trading, borrowing, and lending. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, the firm was formerly known as Maybank Kim Eng Securities (Thailand) Public Company Limited until its rebranding in November 2021. A subsidiary of Maybank Kim Eng Holdings Limited, it operated 28 branches across Bangkok and upcountry regions as of December 31, 2021.
